## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
*Vedanāttika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 11.10) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna division of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text examines conditional causal relations by crossing the triad based on feeling (*vedanāttika*) with the triad based on wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate phenomena (*kusalattika*), structured according to the standard combinatorial methodology of the Paṭṭhāna [SuttaCentral]. The reference literature gathered in the dossier contains no specific citations, translations, or secondary discussions of this particular section.
SuttaCentral notes no curated parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan, and DharmaNexus detects no cross-language matches scoring 10 or above [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated analysis by DharmaNexus records extensive internal text reuse across the Pali Abhidhamma, showing 967 matching passages shared with 65 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The highest degree of textual reuse is found in other sections of the Paṭṭhāna analyzing the same or inverted triads, most notably the standalone *Vedanāttika* (Patthana 1.3, sharing 111 passages and 19,378 characters; and Patthana 13.2, sharing 66 passages), as well as paired treatments such as *Vedanāttika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 17.21, 32 matches) and *Kusalattika, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 23.1, 60 matches; Patthana 17.1, 54 matches) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
